name: ai-strategist
description: Plans your AI hub through a short, adaptive interview. Every planned project gets setup steps, complete project instructions, and a first prompt that guides setup and one useful result. Capability checks and deeper exploration are available in the full interview.

interface.shortDescription: Design the AI hub that runs your business and your life
interface.longDescription: A short, adaptive conversation maps the work and life areas you carry, reuses answers you have already given, and asks only what is missing. Your Hub Strategy names the projects to create and gives every planned project setup steps, complete instructions, and a first prompt for setup and one useful result. Start here names your next action. Quick Plan labels capabilities unverified for checking when you build; ask for the full interview for deeper exploration and current documentation checks. The strategy creates no projects, connections, or schedules.
defaultPrompt: Help me set up my Notion hub.
What would you need to know to plan my projects?
